title: Igokea repeat as Division I champions
description: Borac BL - Igokea 62-76 Igokea defended their Division I title. They overcame Borac BL on the road to sweep the championship series. The guests trailed by 1 point after first quarter, but they stormed back to get the 6-point lead at the halftime and eventually won the game 76-62. Igokea dominated down low during the game scoring 44 of its points in the paint compared to Borac BL's 24. Strangely Borac outrebounded Igokea 44-29 including a 13-2 advantage in offensive rebounds. 24 personal fouls committed by Borac helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. Serbian Mario Nakic (199-2001) orchestrated the victory by scoring 18 points (on 7-of-9 shooting from the field). Croatian point guard Goran Filipovic (183-1996, agency: 011 Sports) contributed with 11 points and 6 assists for the winners. Four Igokea players scored in double figures.
